age_limit.details: Project Associate-I: Maximum Age: 35 Years. Relaxation: Women (5 years), SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwD (10 years) Project Assistant: Maximum Age: 50 Years. Relaxation: Women (5 years), SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwD (10 years)

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences/Biochemistry/Chemistry/Food chemistry/Bioinformatics/Biotechnology/Agricultural Sciences/Agronomy/Genetics and Plant Breeding OR B.Sc. in Agriculture/Life Sciences or 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology/Computer/Information technology
qualification.details: Project Associate-I: Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences/ Biochemistry/ Chemistry/ Food chemistry/ Bioinformatics/ Biotechnology/ Agricultural Sciences/ Agronomy/ Genetics and Plant Breeding. Desirable: Proven hands-on experience in computational analysis and interpretation of biological data, particularly NGS data and strong programming skills in Python, R, or Perl, with experience in scripting under Linux/UNIX environments; Experience in agriculture research for phenotyping, crop management & statistical analysis; Experience in analytical food chemistry; Publications in peer-reviewed high impact journals Project Assistant: B.Sc. in Agriculture/ Life Sciences or 3year Diploma in Engineering & Technology/ Computer/ Information technology. Desirable: Working experience in field experiment, data recording in germplasm collections for phenotyping and crop management & statistical analysis; Proficiency in computer operations (MS office)

salary_details.project associate-i: Rs. 31,000/- + 27 % HRA to Scholars who are selected through (a) National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET (ii) including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE or (b) A selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions. II) 25,000/- + HRA for others who do not fall under (I) above

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR NBPGR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the ICAR-National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (ICAR NBPGR) for temporary research positions under a DBT funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in ICAR NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Project Associate-I and Project Assistant, offering a total of 5 vacancies for eligible candidates holding relevant educational qualifications.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies distributed across Project Associate-I (3 posts) and Project Assistant (2 posts) roles.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date for sending applications via email is 05 October 2026. Candidates must ensure applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is via Email. Candidates need to send their bio-data and scanned copies of original documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Food chemistry, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Agricultural Sciences, Agronomy, or Genetics and Plant Breeding.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Agriculture/Life Sciences or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology, Computer, or Information Technology.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 31,000/- + 27% HRA for qualified national-level exam scholars, and Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for other eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial application screening followed by a physical or online interview conducted by the organization.

faq.question: Q10. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 12 October 2026.
